title: Multiplicativity of the weighted polynomial Gauss norm
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] with a real-valued multiplicative nonarchimedean absolute value $|\cdot|$, and let $r>0$ be real. For $f=\sum_i a_iZ^i\in K[Z]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] define $G_r(f)=\max_i |a_i|r^i$, with $G_r(0)=0$; only the finitely many nonzero coefficients enter the maximum. Then for all $f,g\in K[Z]$, $$G_r(fg)=G_r(f)G_r(g).$$ Completeness and nontriviality of the absolute value are not required.
